title: Real or AI-made?
intro: AI can make pictures, videos and voices that look and sound real. Some of them are called deepfakes.
Sometimes there are clues, like strange hands, blurry writing or shadows that don't match. But new AI makes fewer mistakes, so clues aren't enough.
The best check is the source: who posted it first, and do trusted news sites or adults say the same thing?

game.prompt: Is each one a good way to check whether something is real?

bins.label: Not a good way to check

items.text: Find out who posted it first
items.explain: Knowing the source helps a lot. A real news site is more reliable than an unknown account.

items.text: See whether trusted news sites report the same thing
items.explain: If something big really happened, trusted news will report it too.
A grown-up can help you look into it and decide.

items.text: It has lots of likes, so it must be real
items.explain: Fake things get lots of likes too. Likes don't show what's true.

items.text: It looks very realistic, so it must be real
items.explain: AI can make things look completely real. Looking real is not proof.

items.text: A friend shared it, so it must be real
items.explain: Friends can be fooled too. Check where it came from.

quiz.question: What is a deepfake?
options: A video, picture or voice made by AI to seem real
quiz.explain: A deepfake is fake media made with AI so that it seems real.

quiz.question: What's the best way to check a surprising video?
options: Check who posted it and whether trusted sources agree
quiz.explain: The source and other trusted sources tell you much more than likes.

quiz.question: You hear a voice message that sounds like a famous singer asking for money. What do you think?
options: It must be real because it sounds the same
It could be AI-made, so I don't trust it and ask an adult
quiz.explain: AI can copy voices. Never send money because of a voice, and ask an adult.

summary: AI can make fake pictures, videos and voices that seem real. Don't trust looks or likes; check the source and ask a grown-up you trust.
